testcase.name: Scenario: Change ribbon command size modes while editing a sketch: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-appearance-source/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:227:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change ribbon command size modes while editing a sketch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in the MCAD Software ✔ And Ribbon Appearance is set to Normal ✔ When the user selects Small from the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then command icons become smaller and the command area becomes shorter ✔ And panel titles remain visible ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged ✔ When the user selects Compact from the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then command icons form a dense horizontal layout within the panel groups ✔ And panel titles remain visible ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged ✔ When the user selects Large from the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then command icons become larger and occupy multiple rows ✔ And command labels are hidden ✔ And panel titles remain visible ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged ✔ When the user selects Normal from the Ribbon Appearance submenu ✔ Then the normal mixed-size command layout is restored ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged
